title: Nonsense
description: A new dimension with unique and creative biomes ...
body:
![nonsense_logo_release](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e44a8a8d9e7589707c4d7db9175130feedc0b09.png)

Nonsense adds a new sky-based dimension made of floating islands.
The special feature of the mod is its creative and unique biomes. It starts with one biome, and every major update adds a new one.

### Briza Fields

The first biome is an earthy wasteland filled with rusty mechanical debris and ancient plants and structures.
While it appears empty at first, careful exploration reveals many details and discoveries.

![nonsense_logo_release](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cea45b2256d135fcfdcc6baed243d17346adc899.png)

```
### tiny_wiki

-1 locate a 'mechanical_temple' // underground structure

-2 defeat the 'globuc' // mini boss mob

-3 take the 'portal_crystal_blocks' and build a portal // netherportal like

-4 craft a 'socket_and_steel' and light the portal

-5 explore!

## infos

-1 'kuro_blocks' oxidize slowly in rain

-2 'kuro_blocks' can be waxed with slime_ball, undo with axe // rusty, perishing, scrapped too / or by using a 'slimy_brush'

-3 'dry_betherrack' drops rarely rare items // for example the 'mechanical_mask'

-4 'aolite' will get a use in the next major update

-5 use a name_tag 'cute' or 'repo' on 'robes' or 'trader_robes' for new skins

-6 use a name_tag 'happy' on 'spider_mech' for a new skin

-7 'scrap_armor' is a faster way to get "full netherite" // same armor level
```
